I've successfully fixed the code to make `node test.js` pass. 

The issue was in `broken.js` where the API constant and functions were using "http://legacy.example" instead of "http://api.example". I updated all occurrences of the legacy URL to the expected API URL.

The fix involved:
1. Changing the `API` constant from "http://legacy.example" to "http://api.example"
2. Updating the `url` function to use the new API URL
3. Updating the `health` function to use the new API URL

Now when running `node test.js`, all assertions pass and "OK" is printed to the console.<tool_call>
